tool_args.rationale: The five observations vary u_now but hold the other inputs nearly fixed. An open-branch probe can discriminate among plausible concave mechanisms and reveal behavior outside the narrow pilot before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Cobb-Douglas power law or Haldane curve to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow pilot does not identify the dependence on s_grad or distinguish competing mechanisms outside its range.
The immediate ambiguity concerns the response across input regimes, rather than trajectory resolution; this probe costs more.
It does not resolve the mechanism-identification ambiguity.
